overview.match: Judy Chu is the U.S. Representative
overview.text: Judy Chu is the U.S. Representative for the 28th District, which includes Pasadena and the west San Gabriel Valley. She was first elected to Congress in 2009, after serving on the Monterey Park City Council, in the California State Assembly, and on the State Board of Equalization. In Congress, she serves on the House Ways and Means Committee, where her subcommittee assignments include Health, Worker and Family Support, and Oversight, and on the House Budget Committee. She chaired the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus from 2011 to 2025.
